critical_code_review_comments: CategoryCard.jsx is clean: well-documented, exports CATEGORY_VISUALS map for reuse, has a FALLBACK constant, accessible (aria-label, aria-hidden on decorative icon), uses Link semantically. Minor: 184 cards * 4 absolute-positioned divs each = ~736 layers; on low-end Android the dot-pattern + radial-gradient overlay may cost ~10-20ms during initial paint, but acceptable given visual quality. No action needed.
Landing.jsx categories.map at line 280 uses key={c.category_id} — unique and stable. Good.
manifest.json is well-structured; screenshot labels are in English while rest of manifest is es-US. Consider Spanish labels for consistency (low priority).
